aktivitet.side.privat: Raw activity (apps, window titles, addresses and repos) stays on this computer. Only the time entries you create are synced.
aktivitet.tom.tekst: Nothing was tracked on this day. Is tracking turned on under Settings → Tracking?
aktivitet.liste.label: Blocks
aktivitet.tidslinje.label: Timeline with {n} blocks
aktivitet.taster: Keyboard: ↑↓ move, Space select, Shift+↑↓ extend, T assign, N not work, M merge, D split, Delete delete, ←→ day, L close the day
aktivitet.valg.ingen: Select blocks with click, Space or Shift
aktivitet.tildel.husk_hjaelp: TimeTrack learns from the repo, folder, domain or document and suggests this target next time, including for the rest of the day.
aktivitet.tildel.intet: Select a block that is not already registered.
aktivitet.lignende.tekst: {n} similar blocks today are now suggested for {maal}. Assign them too?
aktivitet.ikke_arbejde.gemt: {n} blocks are marked as not work and will not be suggested again.
aktivitet.ikke_arbejde.gemt_one: 1 block is marked as not work and will not be suggested again.
aktivitet.flet.to: Select at least two blocks to merge.
aktivitet.del.en: Select one block to split it.
aktivitet.del.hjaelp: The block runs {span}. Enter the time to split it at.
aktivitet.del.ugyldig: Enter a time inside the block ({span}).
aktivitet.slet.tekst: The activity in {n} blocks is deleted from this computer for good. Time entries are not touched.
aktivitet.slet.tekst_one: The activity in 1 block is deleted from this computer for good. Time entries are not touched.
aktivitet.luk.faerdig: Everything is settled for today. The day is closed.
aktivitet.luk.uklar: {n} blocks without a client ({tid}). What was it?
aktivitet.luk.uklar_one: 1 block without a client ({tid}). What was it?
aktivitet.luk.uden_projekt_hjaelp: Set a project on them in Calendar if they belong to one.
aktivitet.hjem.uklare: {n} blocks without a client ({tid}). What was it?
aktivitet.hjem.uklare_one: 1 block without a client ({tid}). What was it?
aktivitet.titler.hjaelp: Windows whose title contains the text are never recorded (case does not matter).
aktivitet.data.hjaelp: Raw activity is only stored on this computer and is deleted automatically after the retention period.
aktivitet.data.bekraeft: All raw activity is deleted from this computer for good. Time entries, rules and learned patterns are kept.
aktivitet.fold.hjaelp: Switches shorter than this are folded into the neighbouring block on Activity. 0 shows every switch.
aktivitet.fold.tal: Short switches must be a whole number of seconds
aktivitet.regel.hjaelp: These rules were moved from 0.2 and still apply. Remove the ones you do not want.
aktivitet.luk.spoergsmaal: One question that helps the most
